title: Collective Investment in a Common Pool Resource: Grower Associations and Food Safety Guidelines
Index Insurance and Basis Risk: A Reconsideration
Payments and Penalties in Ecosystem Services Programs
Thinking about Soil Health
Additionality in Payment for Ecosystem Services Programs: Agricultural Conservation Subsidies in Maryland
abstract: Voluntary payment for ecosystem services (PES) programs have been an important means of addressing environmental externalities, especially those from agriculture. Questions have been raised as to the additionality of agricultural PES programs. Many farmers adopt conservation practices voluntarily. Since participation in cost sharing programs is voluntary, it is likely that some farmers are awarded cost share funds to implement conservation practices would have adopted without cost sharing. We investigate the additionality of conservation cost sharing using data from Maryland, a state that has used PES programs aggressively to reduce agricultural nutrient emissions into the Chesapeake Bay and its tributaries. We estimate the number of conservation practices used as a function of the number of conservation practices for which PES payments were received using a two-stage control function approach to control for potential bias. We estimate additionality using the estimated parameters of the second stage model to construct counterfactual estimates of the expected number of practices adopted by each farm with and without cost sharing. Estimated additionality for those receiving cost share funds was quite modest, ranging from 47% to 71%. These results also cast doubt on optimistic projections of the potential for water quality trading to lower costs of meeting water quality goals.
abstract_zh: 自愿性生态系统服务付费（PES）项目一直是解决环境外部性问题的重要手段，尤其是来自农业的外部性。人们对农业PES项目的额外性（additionality）提出了质疑。许多农民本就自愿采取保护措施。由于成本分担项目是自愿参与的，那些获得成本分担资金以实施保护措施的农民中，有一部分人本会在没有成本分担的情况下采取这些措施。我们利用马里兰州的数据进行研究，该州积极利用PES项目来减少农业养分向切萨皮克湾及其支流的排放。我们使用两阶段控制函数方法以校正潜在偏误，估计所采用的保护措施数量与获得PES支付的保护措施数量之间的函数关系。我们利用第二阶段模型的估计参数构造反事实估计，即在有成本分担和无成本分担两种情况下，每个农场预期采用的措施数量。对于获得成本分担资金的农场，估计的额外性相当有限，在47%至71%之间。这些结果也对水质交易能够降低实现水质目标成本的乐观预测提出了质疑。

title: Water Quality Trading in the Presence of Conservation Subsidies
abstract: Most studies of water quality trading analyze its cost-effectiveness in isolation from existing policies like conservation subsidy programs that pay farmers to use conservation practices. We investigate the interaction between trading and conservation subsidy programs using an integrated assessment model that combines farmer behavioral responses with a biophysical water quality model. Current subsidy program enrollees with comparative advantage in nitrogen abatement will sort into the trading program, worsening adverse selection. Actual increases in abatement from trading depend on incentivizing additional conservation practice acreage without inducing the conversion of vegetative cover to cropland. (JEL Q52, Q58)
abstract_zh: 大多数水质交易研究都将其成本效益与现有政策（如向农民支付以采用保护措施的保护补贴计划）相隔离地进行分析。我们利用一个综合评估模型考察交易与保护补贴计划之间的相互作用，该模型结合了农民行为反应与生物物理水质模型。目前补贴计划的参与者中，在氮减排方面具有比较优势的人将进入交易计划，从而加剧逆向选择。交易所带来的实际减排增量，取决于是否能够在不引导植被覆盖转为农田的前提下，激励增加保护措施的面积。（JEL Q52, Q58）

Balancing Act: Economic Incentives, Administrative Restrictions, and Urban Land Expansion in China
Grower Demand for Sensor-Controlled Irrigation
abstract: Water scarcity is likely to increase in the coming years, making improvements in irrigation efficiency increasingly important. An emerging technology that promises to increase irrigation efficiency substantially is a wireless irrigation sensor network that uploads sensor data into irrigation management software, creating an integrated system that allows real-time monitoring and control of moisture status that has been shown in experimental settings to reduce irrigation costs, lower plant loss rates, shorten production times, decrease pesticide application, and increase yield, quality, and profit. We use an original survey to investigate likely initial acceptance, ceiling adoption rates, and profitability of this new sensor network technology in the nursery and greenhouse industry. We find that adoption rates for a base system and demand for expansion components are decreasing in price, as expected. The price elasticity of the probability of adoption suggests that sensor networks are likely to diffuse at a rate somewhat greater than that of drip irrigation. Adoption rates for a base system and demand for expansion components are increasing in specialization in ornamental production: growers earning greater shares of revenue from greenhouse and nursery operations are willing to pay more for a base system and are willing to purchase larger numbers of expansion components at any given price. We estimate that growers who are willing to purchase a sensor network expect investment in this technology to generate significant profit, consistent with findings from experimental studies.
abstract_zh: 水资源稀缺在未来几年可能加剧，使提高灌溉效率变得愈发重要。一项有望大幅提高灌溉效率的新兴技术是无线灌溉传感器网络，该网络将传感器数据上传至灌溉管理软件，形成一个集成系统，可对土壤湿度状况进行实时监测与控制。实验环境中的研究表明，该系统可降低灌溉成本、减少植物损失率、缩短生产周期、减少农药施用，并提高产量、质量和利润。我们利用一项原创调查，考察苗圃和温室行业对这项新型传感器网络技术的可能初始接受度、最终采用率及盈利能力。我们发现，基础系统及扩展组件的采用率均随价格上涨而下降，这与预期一致。采用概率的价格弹性表明，传感器网络的扩散速度可能略快于滴灌。基础系统及扩展组件的需求随观赏植物生产专业化程度的提高而增加：从温室和苗圃业务中获取更大收入比例的种植者，愿意为基础系统支付更高价格，并且在任一价格下愿意购买更多数量的扩展组件。我们估计，愿意购买传感器网络的种植者预期该项投资将带来可观的利润，这与实验研究的结果一致。

title: Econometric Analysis of Grading Standards: The Ordered Fractional Approach
Spending Preferences of Local Officials with Off-Budget Land Revenues of Chinese Cities
Advancing Wireless Sensor Networks for Irrigation Management of Ornamental Crops: An Overview
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) transmit sensor data and control signals over long distances without the need for expensive infrastructure, allowing WSNs to add value to existing irrigation systems since they provide the grower with direct feedback on the water needs of the crop. We implemented WSNs in nine commercial horticulture operations. We provide an overview of the integration of sensors with hardware and software to form WSNs that can monitor and control irrigation water applications based on one of two approaches: 1) “set-point control” based on substrate moisture measurements or 2) “model-based control” that applied species-specific irrigation in response to transpiration estimates. We summarize the economic benefits, current and future challenges, and support issues we currently face for scaling WSNs to entire production sites. The series of papers that follow either directly describe or refer the reader to descriptions of the findings we have made to date. Together, they illustrate that WSNs have been successfully implemented in horticultural operations to greatly reduce water use, with direct economic benefits to growers.
abstract_zh: 无线传感器网络（WSN）无需昂贵的基础设施即可远距离传输传感器数据和控制信号，使其能够为现有灌溉系统增添价值，因为它们可以为种植者提供关于作物需水量的直接反馈。我们在九个商业园艺经营场所中部署了WSN。我们概述了传感器与硬件和软件的集成方式，以形成可基于两种方法之一监测和控制灌溉用水的WSN：1）基于基质湿度测量的“设定值控制”，或2）根据蒸腾估计值实施针对特定物种灌溉的“模型控制”。我们总结了其经济效益、当前和未来的挑战，以及在将WSN扩展至整个生产场地时目前面临的支持性问题。随后的系列论文直接描述或指引读者参阅我们迄今取得的研究发现。综合来看，这些研究表明，WSN已在园艺经营中成功应用，能够大幅减少用水量，并为种植者带来直接的经济效益。

title: Competitiveness of Management-Intensive Grazing Dairies in the Mid-Atlantic from 1995 to 2009
Costs and Benefits of Implementing Sensor-Controlled Irrigation in a Commercial Pot-in-Pot Container Nursery
abstract:
Irrigation scheduling in ornamental plant production is complex due to the large number of species grown by individual growers and the need to consider plant, environment, and substrate conditions to make correct irrigation decisions on a daily or more frequent basis. The engineering team in our project has developed a smart wireless sensor node that is capable of integrating outputs from a range of soil moisture and environmental sensors to schedule irrigation events. In addition, an advanced monitoring and control software enables growers to manage irrigation based on set-point or model-based protocols, which are then independently executed by the nodes, enhancing or replacing human decision making. During 2012, we implemented a sensor-controlled vs. grower-controlled irrigation study at a pot-in-pot nursery in Tennessee. Sensor networks were installed in two separate production blocks of 3-year-old dogwood (
Cornus florida
‘Cherokee Brave’) and 2-year-old red maple (
Acer rubrum
‘Autumn Blaze’) trees grown in 15- and 30-gal containers, respectively. One row of trees in each block was irrigated based on the average reading of soil moisture sensors inserted in individual trees using micropulse irrigation, i.e., sensor controlled. Trees in the adjacent row and the rest of the block were independently irrigated by the grower using standard practices, i.e., grower controlled. Sensor volumetric water content (VWC) readings and irrigation volumes were logged by nodes on a 15-min basis and were relayed to a base station on the farm. For the study period between Mar. 2012 and Nov. 2012, average daily water applied by the grower-controlled irrigation to the dogwood block was 0.92 gal/tree, compared with 0.34 gal/tree applied using sensor-controlled irrigation; for red maple, these values were 1.72 gal/tree and 1.13 gal/tree, respectively. No significant differences in tree caliper or quality were noted between the two irrigation treatments in either species over the year. The cost of water for this particular operation was negligible consisting only of pumping costs, as water is drawn from a perennial stream with excellent water quality. Consequently, a conservative return on investment for a wireless sensor network capable of covering the entire operation was 37.5%, corresponding to a payback period of 2.7 years, associated almost entirely from a reduction in irrigation management time. Pricing in a nominal cost for water of $326 per acre-foot ($1 per 1000 gal) increased annualized net savings 9-fold, reducing the payback period to less than 4 months. This analysis did not factor in additional economic benefits such as reductions in production time, losses due to disease, or increased plant quality, which have been associated with the use of sensor-based irrigation control in other studies.
abstract_zh: 观赏植物生产中的灌溉调度十分复杂，原因在于种植者栽培的物种繁多，且需要综合考虑植株、环境和基质条件，才能每日或更频繁地做出正确的灌溉决策。我们项目的工程团队开发了一种智能无线传感器节点，能够整合多种土壤湿度和环境传感器的输出，以安排灌溉事件。此外，一套先进的监测与控制软件使种植者能够基于设定值或模型协议管理灌溉，这些协议由节点独立执行，从而增强或取代人工决策。2012年，我们在田纳西州的一家盆中盆（pot-in-pot）苗圃开展了传感器控制与种植者控制灌溉的对比研究。传感器网络被安装在两个独立的生产区块中，分别种植于15加仑和30加仑容器中的3年生山茱萸（Cornus florida ‘Cherokee Brave’）和2年生红枫（Acer rubrum ‘Autumn Blaze’）。每个区块中的一行树木采用微脉冲灌溉，依据插入个体树木中的土壤湿度传感器的平均读数进行灌溉，即传感器控制。相邻一行树木及该区块其余部分则由种植者按照标准做法独立灌溉，即种植者控制。土壤体积含水量（VWC）读数和灌溉水量每15分钟由节点记录一次，并传输至农场的基站。在2012年3月至11月的研究期间，种植者控制灌溉下山茱萸区块的日均施水量为每株0.92加仑，而传感器控制灌溉下为每株0.34加仑；对于红枫，这两个数值分别为1.72加仑和1.13加仑。全年来看，两种灌溉处理在两个物种的树干直径或质量上均未出现显著差异。该运营场所的水费几乎可以忽略，仅包括抽水成本，因为水取自一条水质极佳的常年溪流。因此，若采用无线传感器网络覆盖整个运营场所，其保守的投资回报率为37.5%，对应回收期为2.7年，且几乎全部收益来自灌溉管理时间的减少。若按每英亩英尺326美元（即每1000加仑1美元）计入名义水价，年化净节省额增加至9倍，回收期缩短至不足4个月。该分析未计入其他经济效益，例如生产时间的缩短、病害损失的减少或植株质量的提高，而这些效益在其他研究中已被证实与基于传感器的灌溉控制相关。

title: Ornamental Grower Perceptions of Sensor Networks
Profitability of Sensor-Based Irrigation in Greenhouse and Nursery Crops
abstract:
Improvements in sensor technology coupled with advances in knowledge about plant physiology have made it feasible to use real-time substrate volumetric water content sensors to accurately determine irrigation timing and application rates in soilless substrates in greenhouse and container production environments. Sensor-based irrigation uses up-front investments in equipment and system calibration in return for subsequent reductions in irrigation water use and associated costs of energy and labor, spending on fertilizer, and disease losses. It can also accelerate production time. We present formulas for assessing profitability when benefits and costs are separated in time and apply those formulas using data from an experiment on production of gardenia [
Gardenia augusta
‘MADGA 1’ (Heaven Scent™)]. Sensor
-
controlled irrigation cuts production time and crop losses by more than half. Annualized profit under the wireless sensor system was over 1.5 more than under the nursery’s standard practice, with the bulk of the increase in profit due to the reduction in production time. These results indicate that controlling irrigation using wireless sensor systems is likely to increase profitability substantially, even if efficiency gains are not as high as those achieved under experimental conditions.
abstract_zh: 传感器技术的改进，加上植物生理学知识的进步，使得利用实时基质体积含水量传感器准确确定无土基质中的灌溉时机和施水量成为可能，这适用于温室和容器栽培环境。基于传感器的灌溉需要预先投入设备并进行系统校准，以换取后续在灌溉用水及相关能源和劳动力成本、肥料支出以及病害损失方面的降低。它还能加快生产周期。当效益与成本在时间上分离时，我们给出了评估盈利能力的公式，并利用栀子花（Gardenia augusta ‘MADGA 1’（Heaven Scent™））的生产实验数据进行了应用。传感器控制灌溉使生产周期和作物损失减少了一半以上。在无线传感器系统下，年化利润比苗圃的标准做法高出1.5倍以上，利润增加的大部分来自生产时间的缩短。这些结果表明，即使效率提升未能达到实验条件下的水平，利用无线传感器系统控制灌溉仍可能大幅提高盈利能力。

title: Land and Urban Economic Growth in China
Open Space and Urban Sprawl: The Case of the Maryland Forest Conservation Act
Slippage in Conservation Cost Sharing
abstract: We examine whether subsidies for conservation on working farmland induce farmers to expand cultivation on more vulnerable land, potentially offsetting reductions in environmental spillovers, using a switching regression model with endogenous switching and censored endogenous variables applied to Maryland farm‐level data. We find no indication that cost share awards are targeted toward water quality improvements. Receipt of cost sharing increases conservation practice adoption but not the shares of land allocated to conservation, implying little adverse selection in awards. Cost sharing decreases the share of land allocated to vegetative cover, so that environmental quality improvements from conservation are likely offset to some degree.
abstract_zh: 我们使用具有内生转换和受限内生变量的转换回归模型，以马里兰州农场层面的数据为基础，考察对耕地保护的补贴是否会促使农民将耕作扩展到更脆弱的土地上，从而可能抵消环境外部效益的改善。我们没有发现证据表明成本分担奖励是针对水质改善而定向发放的。获得成本分担使保护措施的采用率提高，但并未增加用于保护的土地份额，这意味着奖励中几乎不存在逆向选择。成本分担减少了用于植被覆盖的土地份额，因此，保护措施带来的环境质量改善很可能在一定程度上被抵消。

title: Agri-Environmental Program Compliance in a Heterogeneous Landscape
Economics of Health Risk Assessment
Natural Resource Economics and Conservation: Contributions of Agricultural Economics and Agricultural Economists
abstract: Research by agricultural economists on natural resources has been distinguished by an interdisciplinary emphasis and a dynamic perspective. It has recognized technological and institutional constraints, has been oriented toward solving concrete resource management and policy problems, and has emphasized empirical and quantitative analysis. Agricultural economists have introduced methods for evaluating natural resource conservation efforts, for predicting adoption of resource conservation technologies, and for designing efficient and sustainable resource management policies. They have identified ways of improving land management and preventing land degradation, proposed reforms of institutions governing water allocation and water quality, and introduced policies for balancing environmental and efficiency considerations in the management of pests, biodiversity, and livestock diseases. Their research has had substantial impacts on the formulation of resource conservation policies.
abstract_zh: 农业经济学家对自然资源的研究，以跨学科的重视和动态的视角为特征。他们认识到技术和制度的约束，致力于解决具体的资源管理和政策问题，并强调实证与定量分析。农业经济学家引入了评估自然资源保护努力、预测保护技术采用情况以及设计高效、可持续资源管理政策的方法。他们确定了改善土地管理和防止土地退化的途径，提出了改革水资源配置和水质治理制度的建议，并提出了在病虫害、生物多样性和牲畜疾病管理中兼顾环境与效率的政策。他们的研究对资源保护政策的制定产生了重大影响。

title: Open Space, Forest Conservation, and Urban Sprawl in Maryland Suburban Subdivisions
abstract: Rapidly urbanizing jurisdictions face substan-tial challenges in maintaining the provision of public goods like preservation of open space and other scenic amenities. Numerous em-pirical studies have demonstrated that the presence of open space increases residential property values, suggesting that households place a positive value on this public good
abstract_zh: 快速城市化的司法辖区在维持公共物品供给方面面临重大挑战，例如保护开放空间和其他景观美学资源。大量实证研究表明，开放空间的存在会提高住宅房产价值，这表明家庭对这一公共物品赋予了正面价值。

title: Regulation, Open Space, and the Value of Land Undergoing Residential Subdivision
Tenants, Landlords, and Soil Conservation
abstract: It has long been argued that tenants tend to overexploit land, but this conventional wisdom has been derived largely without consideration of landlords' actions. We examine what happens when landlords can invest in durable conservation measures in addition to choosing rental contract terms. When tenants are risk neutral, landlords overinvest in conservation under cash rental contracts but can achieve first best levels of output and protection against land degradation when conservation investment is combined with share rental. When tenants are risk averse, the first best is unattainable. In this case, conservation investment combined with share rental results in output levels below the first best, while equilibrium conservation investment may be greater or less than the first best. These results suggest that contract form and conservation investments are likely made simultaneously, so that econometric studies of conservation practice adoption that treat rental status as exogenous are likely subject to bias.
abstract_zh: 长期以来人们认为，租户往往会过度开发土地，但这一传统观点在很大程度上是在未考虑房东行为的情况下得出的。我们考察了当房东除选择租赁合同条款外，还能投资于耐久性保护措施时会发生什么。当租户为风险中性时，在现金租赁合同下房东会过度投资于保护；而当保护投资与分成租赁相结合时，可以达到第一最优的产出水平，并防止土地退化。当租户为风险厌恶时，第一最优无法实现。在这种情况下，保护投资与分成租赁相结合会导致产出低于第一最优水平，而均衡时的保护投资可能高于或低于第一最优水平。这些结果表明，合同形式与保护投资很可能同时决定，因此，将租赁身份视为外生变量的保护措施采用实证研究很可能存在偏误。

title: Are Green Payments Good for the Environment?
abstract: There is growing interest in green payments subsidizing conservation measures on working farmland based on the premise that they have positive effects on the environment and agriculture simultaneously without causing international trade distortions. This paper uses a Ricardian land market equilibrium model to examine the impacts of green payments. The analysis shows green payments can worsen ambient pollution damage by subsidizing the expansion of more intensive crop cultivation. Some forms of green can increase cultivation intensity (and thus environmental damage) as well. These adverse effects can be avoided by careful targeting, but such targeting is likely to be quite difficult.
abstract_zh: 人们对绿色支付（green payments）的兴趣日益增长，即对耕地上的保护措施给予补贴，其前提是这些措施能同时对环境和农业产生积极影响，且不会引起国际贸易扭曲。本文使用李嘉图（Ricardian）土地市场均衡模型，考察绿色支付的影响。分析表明，绿色支付可能通过补贴集约化程度更高的作物种植扩张而加剧环境污染损害。某些形式的绿色支付也可能提高种植集约度（从而加剧环境损害）。这些不利影响可以通过精准的目标定位加以避免，但此类定位可能相当困难。

title: Hard Truths about Agriculture and the Environment
abstract: Environmental problems in agriculture have proven difficult to address due to the spatial heterogeneity and temporal variability intrinsic to agriculture. Agriculture is largely a struggle against nature; both its sustainability and the prospects for improving environmental performance and farm income simultaneously are thus inherently limited. Agriculture's high degree of variability makes direct regulation inefficient. Subsidies for improving environmental performance can have negative consequences and have proven ineffective in practice, due largely to bureaucratic culture. Pollution taxes should be the most effective and efficient form of policy. Interdisciplinary research is needed to provide models for performance evaluation.
abstract_zh: 由于农业固有的空间异质性和时间变动性，农业环境问题一直难以解决。农业在很大程度上是人与自然的斗争；因此，其可持续性，以及同时改善环境绩效与农场收入的前景，本质上都是有限的。农业的高度变异性使直接监管效率低下。改善环境绩效的补贴可能产生负面后果，并且由于官僚文化等原因，在实践中已被证明效果不佳。污染税应是最有效、最高效的政策形式。需要开展跨学科研究，为绩效评估提供模型。

title: Prevention versus Treatment under Precautionary Regulation: A Case Study of Groundwater Contamination under Uncertainty
abstract: Policy discussions on agricultural pollution problems characterize prevention as more cost effective and precautionary than ex post treatment. We derive conditions under which treatment alone is more cost effective in situations involving multiple sources of emissions, multiple sites affected, and a commonly used precautionary approach to uncertainty. We also show that a greater degree of precaution can result in less reliance on prevention. An empirical case study indicates that treatment alone is the most cost‐effective means of dealing with nitrate in most Maryland community water system wells. The use of leaching prevention measures is restricted to the most intensive poultry producing areas. The incremental cost of precaution is substantial.
abstract_zh: 关于农业污染问题的政策讨论通常认为，预防比事后治理更具成本效益，也更为审慎。我们推导了在涉及多个排放源、多个受影响地点以及常用的不确定性审慎方法的情形下，仅采用治理手段更具成本效益的条件。我们还表明，更大程度的审慎可能导致对预防措施的依赖减少。一项实证案例研究表明，在马里兰州大多数社区供水井中，仅采用治理手段是应对硝酸盐问题最具成本效益的方式。渗漏预防措施仅限于养殖家禽最为密集的地区。审慎行事的增量成本十分可观。

title: Storage Technology and the Environment
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics

title: Priorities in Cost Sharing for Soil and Water Conservation: A Revealed Preference Study
abstract: A number of studies have questioned how successfully paid land diversion has been adapted to address broad environmental policy concerns. Similar evaluations of cost-sharing programs have not been performed. This paper uses a revealed preference approach to estimate the implicit decision criteria used to allocate federal cost-sharing funds in Maryland, during the fiscal years 1994 through 1996. Funds appear to have been awarded preferentially to projects that enhanced agricultural productivity and farm profitability. In contrast to findings regarding the CRP, however, our results do not indicate that cost share awards in Maryland were inconsistent with stated environmental quality priorities. (JEL Q24, Q25)
abstract_zh: 许多研究质疑付费土地休耕在多大程度上成功地服务于广泛的环境政策目标。对成本分担项目的类似评估此前尚未开展。本文采用显示性偏好方法，估计了1994至1996财政年度马里兰州在分配联邦成本分担资金时所使用的隐含决策标准。资金似乎优先分配给了提高农业生产率和农场盈利能力的项目。与关于保护储备计划（CRP）的研究结论不同，我们的结果并未表明马里兰州的成本分担奖励与其既定的环境质量优先事项不一致。（JEL Q24，Q25）

title: Adverse Health Effects, Environmental Attitudes, and Pesticide Usage Behavior of Farm Operators
Farmers' Willingness to Pay for Groundwater Protection
abstract: The effectiveness of current groundwater protection policies depends largely on farmers' voluntary compliance with leaching reduction measures, an important component of which is their willingness to adopt costlier production practices in order to prevent leaching of chemicals. Data from an original survey of 1611 corn and soybean growers in the mid‐Atlantic region were used to estimate farmers' willingness to pay to prevent leaching of pesticides into groundwater. The results indicate that farmers are willing to pay more for leaching prevention than nonfarm groundwater consumers, both absolutely and relative to total income. The primary motivation appears to be concern for overall environmental quality rather than protection of drinking water or the health and safety of themselves and their families. Hobby farmers are willing to pay more than farmers with commercial activity. Certified pesticide applicators are willing to pay less than farmers without certification.
abstract_zh: 当前地下水保护政策的有效性，在很大程度上取决于农民对减少渗漏措施的自愿遵守情况，其中一个重要组成部分是他们是否愿意采用成本更高的生产方式，以防止化学品渗入地下水。我们利用对大西洋中部地区1611名玉米和大豆种植者的原创调查数据，估计了农民为防止农药渗入地下水而愿意支付的金额。结果表明，无论是绝对金额还是相对于总收入，农民为防止渗漏而愿意支付的金额都高于非农业地下水消费者。其主要动机似乎是对整体环境质量的关切，而非保护饮用水或自身及家人的健康与安全。业余农户比从事商业经营的农民愿意支付更多。持有农药施用认证的人，其愿意支付的金额低于未获认证的农民。

title: Information and Farmers' Attitudes about Pesticides, Water Quality, and Related Environmental Effects
Using Dominance in Forming Bounds on DEA Models: The Case of Experimental Agricultural Data
Agriculture and Nitrate Concentrations in Maryland Community Water System Wells
abstract:
The presence of NO
3
‐N in well water is a cause of growing concern throughout the USA. Previous studies indicate that agriculture is a major contributor to this problem. This study uses data on NO
3
‐N concentrations in drinking water wells, on hydrological characteristics of those wells, and on measures of agricultural activity and of the extent of residential land use to construct statistical relationships between land use and well water quality in Maryland community water system wells. Tobit regression was used to correct for truncation bias arising from the fact that NO
3
‐N was not reported at concentrations below 0.1 mg/L. Exponential and linear specifications were estimated; non‐nested hypothesis tests indicated that the exponential specification fit the data better than the linear one. Deeper wells appear less vulnerable to NO
3
‐N contamination, wells in unconfined aquifers and especially limestone formations, more so. Broiler and corn (
Zea mays
L.) production were associated with higher NO
3
‐N concentrations in drinking water in both specifications, indicating that agriculture‐oriented efforts aimed at preserving groundwater quality should be concentrated on corn and broiler production. Septic systems for waste disposal also appear to have a substantial impact on NO
3
‐N concentrations in drinking water, suggesting that land use planning measures such as minimum lot size zoning may be needed to prevent conversion of crop and livestock production to residential units relying on septic systems from exacerbating groundwater quality problems.
abstract_zh: 井水中的硝酸盐氮（NO3-N）是美国各地日益受到关注的问题。既往研究表明，农业是造成这一问题的主要原因。本研究利用饮用水井中NO3-N的浓度数据、这些水井的水文特征，以及农业活动和居住用地范围的测度指标，构建了马里兰州社区供水系统水井中土地利用与水质之间的统计关系。由于NO3-N在浓度低于0.1 mg/L时未被报告，我们采用Tobit回归以校正截断偏误。我们估计了指数和线性两种设定；非嵌套假设检验表明，指数设定比线性设定更好地拟合数据。较深的水井受硝酸盐氮污染的可能性较小，位于非承压含水层中的水井更是如此，而位于石灰岩地层中的水井则尤为如此。在两种设定中，肉鸡养殖和玉米（Zea mays L.）生产均与饮用水中较高的NO3-N浓度相关，这表明旨在保护地下水质量的农业措施应集中于玉米和肉鸡生产。化粪池式废物处理系统似乎也对饮用水中的NO3-N浓度产生了重大影响，这表明可能需要采取土地利用规划措施（如最小地块面积分区），以防止作物和畜牧生产转为依赖化粪池系统的住宅用途，从而加剧地下水质量问题。

title: Organic versus Conventional Grain Production in the Mid-Atlantic: An Economic and Farming System Overview
abstract: A farming systems trial has been conducted at the Rodale Institute Research Center in Kutztown, Pennsylvania since 1981. Over time, the organic rotation has changed to reflect improved knowledge and experience. The current, three-year rotation (hairy vetch/corn, rye/soybeans, and wheat) focuses on mechanical tillage for weed control and year-round live plant cover for pest control and nutrient supply. We constructed long-term enterprise budgets for the organic and conventional cash grain rotations and compared returns earned during the first years of the study, which for the organic rotation involved investment in soil capital, with returns during two later 5-year periods. The organic rotations during these two later periods produced com and soybean yields comparable with the conventional rotation, but grew higher-value crops less frequently and required more family labor and management. The differences in the profitability of the conventional and organic farming systems depend on whether the analysis includes the initial investment in building up the soil and the value of family labor.
abstract_zh: 自1981年以来，宾夕法尼亚州库茨敦（Kutztown）的罗代尔研究所（Rodale Institute）研究中心一直开展农业系统试验。随着知识和经验的积累，有机轮作也随之调整。当前的三年期轮作（毛苕子/玉米、黑麦/大豆和小麦）侧重于通过机械耕作控制杂草，并通过全年活体植被覆盖来控制病虫害和提供养分。我们为有机和传统谷物轮作编制了长期企业预算，并比较了研究初期的收益与后期两个5年期的收益，其中有机轮作在研究初期涉及对土壤资本的投资。在后两个时期，有机轮作的玉米和大豆产量与传统轮作相当，但种植高价值作物的频率较低，且需要投入更多的家庭劳动力和管理。传统与有机农业系统的盈利能力差异，取决于分析中是否包括土壤培肥的前期投资以及家庭劳动力的价值。

title: The Economics of Cosmetic Pesticide Use
A Nonparametric Approach to the von Liebig-Paris Technology
Optimal Combination of Pollution Prevention and Abatement Policies: The Case of Agricultural Drainage
Partial versus General Storage Policy: Commodities and Resources
Risk-Reducing and Risk-Increasing Effects of Pesticides
Simple Econometrics of Pesticide Productivity
The Profitability of Legume Cover Crops in the Mid-Atlantic Region
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: Data from agronomic field trials in Maryland were used to construct nitrogen response functions for no-till corn following four cover crops and winter fallow. The estimated nitrogen response functions were used to estimate profit-maximizing nitrogen application rates and maximum profit under each treatment. Hairy vetch proved more profitable than crimson clover, Austrian peas, wheat, or fallow under a wide range of prices for corn, nitrogen and vetch seed and of herbicide costs. A hairy vetch-corn rotation exhibited small savings in nitrogen relative to wheat-corn or fallow-corn rotations at profit-maximizing application rates, perhaps because vetch improves nitrogen uptake and thus increases the marginal productivity of nitrogen.
abstract_zh: 利用马里兰州的农田试验数据，我们构建了免耕玉米在四种覆盖作物和冬季休耕之后的氮肥响应函数。估计的氮肥响应函数被用于计算各处理下的利润最大化施氮量及最大利润。在玉米、氮肥和毛苕子种子价格以及除草剂成本的较宽范围内，毛苕子的盈利能力均高于深红三叶草、奥地利豌豆、小麦或休耕。在利润最大化的施用率下，毛苕子-玉米轮作相较于小麦-玉米或休耕-玉米轮作，表现出较小的氮素节约，这可能是因为毛苕子改善了氮素吸收，从而提高了氮的边际生产率。

title: Choice of Hospital for Delivery: A Comparison of High-Risk and Low-Risk Women
Insurance, Moral Hazard and Chemical Use in Agriculture
abstract: This paper examines how crop insurance affects corn farmers' fertilizer and pesticide use in the U.S. Midwest. Crop insurance might be expected to affect chemical use because of “moral hazard”; insured farmers may undertake riskier production than do uninsured farmers. Results suggest that insurance exerts considerable influence on corn farmers' chemical use decisions. Those purchasing insurance applied significantly more nitrogen per acre (19%), spent more on pesticides (21%), and treated more acreage with both herbicides and insecticides (7% and 63%) than did those not purchasing insurance. These results suggest that both fertilizer and pesticides may be risk‐increasing inputs.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了作物保险如何影响美国中西部玉米种植者的化肥和农药使用。由于存在“道德风险”，作物保险可能会影响化学品的使用：投保农民可能比未投保农民从事风险更高的生产。结果表明，保险对玉米种植者的化学品使用决策有相当大的影响。相较于未购买保险的农民，购买保险的农民每英亩施用的氮肥多19%，农药支出多21%，并且使用除草剂和杀虫剂处理的耕地面积分别多7%和63%。这些结果表明，化肥和农药都可能是增加风险的投入品。

title: The Economics of Re-Entry Regulation of Pesticides
The Profitability of No-Tillage Corn Following a Hairy Vetch Cover Crop in the Mid-Atlantic Region
Alternative Approaches to Pesticide Policy

title: The Impacts of Damage Control on the Quantity and Quality of Output: Estimating Pest Control Effectiveness
Water Quality, Cost-Sharing and Technical Assistance: Perceptions of Maryland Farmers
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: Data from a recent survey of Maryland fanners was used to study farmers' perceptions of three topics relating to the use of soil and nutrient runoff control in agriculture: the extent of water quality problems, the usefulness of cost-sharing, and the perceived value of different sources of information on soil and water conservation. The evidence indicates that, while farmers recognized the existence of water quality problems, they tended to believe those problems occur away from their farm or local area. Cost-sharing appeared to have influenced a limited number of farmers to plan increased runoff control efforts. Outreach efforts by public agencies may need improvement.
abstract_zh: 我们利用近期对马里兰州农民的调查数据，研究了农民对农业土壤与养分径流控制相关的三个议题的认知：水质问题的严重程度、成本分担的效用，以及不同土壤和水土保持信息来源的感知价值。证据表明，尽管农民认识到水质问题的存在，但他们往往认为这些问题发生在其农场或当地地区之外。成本分担似乎促使少数农民计划加大径流控制力度。公共机构的推广工作可能需要改进。

title: Modeling the Effect of Hospital Charges and Quality on Choice
Risk Assessment, Economics and Chemicals in Food
The Economics of Pesticide Use and Regulation
Does Quality Influence Choice of Hospital?

title: The Effects of Pricing Policies on Water Conservation and Drainage
abstract: A general model of adoption of input‐conserving technologies by competitive firms is introduced using drip irrigation as an example. An environmental regulation such as a drainage effluent charge is shown to influence adoption. Early adopters are likely to be producers with less efficient fixed assets (land of low quality or antiquated capital), higher input costs (higher water prices or greater depth to groundwater), and in more environmentally sensitive regions. Simulations show that drainage regulations can be expected to play a major role in adoption of more efficient irrigation technologies in California. Thus, conservation may be a key to solving resource scarcity problems and reducing external environmental costs.
abstract_zh: 本文以滴灌为例，构建了竞争性企业采用节水型投入技术的一般模型。研究表明，排水废水收费等环境监管会影响技术的采用。早期采用者可能是那些固定资产效率较低（土地质量较差或设备陈旧）、投入成本较高（水价较高或地下水埋深较大）且处于环境敏感地区的生产者。模拟结果表明，排水监管有望在加利福尼亚州采用更高效灌溉技术的过程中发挥重要作用。因此，节约用水可能是解决资源稀缺问题、降低外部环境成本的关键。

title: Land Quality, Irrigation Development and Cropping Patterns in the Northern High Plains
abstract: This article examines the interactions between land quality, crop choice, and technological change using a framework that integrates cross-sectional and intertemporal aspects of diffusion. The empirical results indicate that (a) the acreages allocated to different crops vary significantly over land quality, (b) crops tend to be grown on specific ranges of land quality, (c) the introduction of center pivot technology induced significant changes in cropping patterns, (d) land quality-augmenting technologies tend to be utilized primarily on lower qualities of land, and (e) irrigation development has been quite sensitive to tax policies.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一个整合了横截面与跨期扩散视角的框架，考察了土地质量、作物选择与技术变革之间的相互作用。实证结果表明：（a）分配给不同作物的面积随土地质量显著变化；（b）作物倾向于种植在特定的土地质量区间；（c）中心支轴喷灌技术的引入引发了种植模式的显著变化；（d）提升土地质量的技术主要应用于质量较低的土地；（e）灌溉开发对税收政策相当敏感。

title: Regulating Environmental Health Risks Under Uncertainty: Groundwater Contamination in California
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: The Sensitivity of Conditional Choice Models for Hospital Care to Estimation Technique
Efficient Regulation of Environmental Health Risks
abstract: This paper introduces a decision framework for regulating environmental health risks which incorporates the characteristic uncertainty about the dissemination and toxicological impacts of environmental contaminants and the behavioral restrictions commonly encountered. Analysis indicates that increases in uncontrollable uncertainty will increase emphasis on average performance, that more potent or less controllable risks will be regulated more stringently and that increasing aversion to uncertainty may result in poorer average performance. The paper also develops an alternative measure for valuing risk of loss of life taking into account uncertainty about health risk generation processes.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个环境健康风险监管的决策框架，该框架纳入了环境污染物传播与毒理影响中固有的不确定性，以及常见的行为约束。分析表明，不可控不确定性的增加将使监管更加强调平均表现；更具危害性或更难控制的风险将受到更严格的监管；而对不确定性的厌恶程度上升，可能导致平均表现变差。本文还提出了一种替代性的生命损失风险估值方法，该方法考虑了健康风险生成过程中的不确定性。

title: Marginal Analysis of Welfare Effects of Environmental Policies: The Case of Pesticide Regulation
Regulation of Marine Contamination under Environmental Uncertainty: Shellfish Contamination in California
abstract: We develop a model of regulation of environmental risks in a heterogeneous industry when policy makers are sensitive to uncertainties about the processes generating the risks. Optimal source reduction capacity is shown to vary according to site suitability. Optimal source reduction capacity and the implicit value of risk reduction increase as risk standards become more stringent and as aversion to uncertainty grows. Taxes are more equitable than standards whenever the emissions generating the risks are all-or-nothing. These results are illustrated for a case of public health regulation of dairy wastes producing enhanced risk of acute gastroenteritis through contamination of a shellflshery. Aversion to uncertainty influences investment in pollution control substantially. The premium in pollution control costs imposed by an increase in the required margin of safety increases as aversion to uncertainty grows and as the risk standard becomes more stringent, as do the implicit value of risk reduction and optimal tax. Taxes are more equitable than standards for lax risk standards but become less so as the risk standard becomes more stringent.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个异质性行业中环境风险监管的模型，其中决策者对产生风险的过程中的不确定性较为敏感。研究表明，最优的源头削减能力随场地适宜性而变化。随着风险标准趋于严格以及对不确定性的厌恶程度增加，最优源头削减能力和风险削减的隐含价值都会上升。当产生风险的排放是全有或全无时，税收比标准更为公平。这些结果以公共卫生监管为例进行了说明：对乳制品废水的监管，其通过污染贝类渔场而增加了急性肠胃炎的风险。对不确定性的厌恶显著影响污染控制投资。当要求的安全边际提高时，污染控制成本的溢价随对不确定性的厌恶程度增加和风险标准趋于严格而上升，风险削减的隐含价值和最优税率也随之上升。对于宽松的风险标准，税收比标准更为公平，但随着风险标准趋于严格，这一优势逐渐减弱。

The Econometrics of Damage Control: Why Specification Matters
